_description: MOCK: Meeting type detection keywords and template customizations. Replace with actual sales methodology definitions from sales enablement. This should come from: (1) Sales playbook documentation, (2) Meeting type classification rules, (3) Stage-specific talking points.
_replaceWith: Import from sales playbook or methodology training materials

first_call.name: First Call / Intro
first_call.description: Initial introduction meeting with a prospect

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a FIRST CALL. Focus on discovery, rapport building, and initial qualification. Avoid assuming prior context.
keyFocus: Research company background and recent news
Understand attendee roles and decision-making power
Prepare broad discovery questions (pain points, current solutions)
Have a flexible agenda - follow their lead
Identify potential champions early
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Curious and consultative. Ask more than tell.

discovery.name: Discovery
discovery.description: Deep-dive discovery to understand requirements and pain points

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a DISCOVERY call. Focus on uncovering detailed requirements, pain points, and decision criteria.
keyFocus: Prepare targeted questions based on previous call insights
Map technical requirements to product capabilities
Identify evaluation criteria and success metrics
Understand decision process and timeline
Probe for competitive alternatives being considered

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a DEMO call. Focus on showcasing relevant features tied to their specific pain points and use cases.
keyFocus: Customize demo to their stated pain points
Prepare specific examples relevant to their industry/use case
Anticipate technical questions and objections
Have competitive differentiators ready
Plan interactive moments to engage attendees
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Confident and engaging. Show, don't just tell.

poc_kickoff.name: POC Kickoff
poc_kickoff.description: Proof of Concept or trial kickoff meeting

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a POC KICKOFF. Focus on defining clear success criteria, timeline, and stakeholder alignment.
keyFocus: Define specific, measurable success criteria
Align on POC timeline and milestones
Identify technical stakeholders and their roles
Establish communication cadence
Set expectations for support and engagement
Discuss what happens after POC (decision process)
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Organized and collaborative. Set clear expectations.

poc_review.name: POC Review / Check-in
poc_review.description: Mid-POC review or final POC evaluation meeting

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a POC REVIEW. Focus on measuring against success criteria and addressing blockers.
keyFocus: Review progress against defined success criteria
Identify and address any blockers or concerns
Gather feedback from all stakeholders
Discuss next steps if criteria are met
Probe for competitive pressure or timeline changes
Confirm decision process and approvers
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Supportive and action-oriented. Drive toward decision.

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a NEGOTIATION call. Focus on understanding their constraints and finding win-win solutions.
keyFocus: Know your pricing flexibility and approval requirements
Understand their budget constraints and fiscal calendar
Identify procurement process and timeline
Prepare for common objections (price, terms, competition)
Have value justification ready (ROI, TCO)
Know what you can trade (terms, support, implementation)
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Professional and flexible. Seek mutual value.

executive_briefing.name: Executive Briefing
executive_briefing.description: Meeting with C-level or VP-level executives

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is an EXECUTIVE meeting. Focus on strategic value, business outcomes, and ROI. Avoid technical deep-dives unless asked.
keyFocus: Lead with business outcomes, not features
Have ROI/TCO data ready
Understand their strategic priorities
Be prepared to discuss partnership and long-term vision
Know competitive positioning at the strategic level
Be concise - executives have limited time
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Confident and strategic. Be concise and outcome-focused.

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a TECHNICAL call. Focus on architecture, integrations, security, and implementation details.
keyFocus: Review their technical environment and requirements
Prepare for integration and API questions
Have security and compliance documentation ready
Understand their deployment preferences
Be ready to discuss scalability and performance
Identify technical blockers early
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Technical and precise. Speak their language.

follow_up.name: Follow-up / Check-in
follow_up.description: General follow-up or status check meeting

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: This is a FOLLOW-UP call. Review previous commitments and push for momentum.
keyFocus: Review action items from previous calls
Check on any blockers or concerns
Identify changes in stakeholders or priorities
Push for next concrete milestone
Address any stalled momentum

unknown.name: General Meeting
unknown.description: Meeting type could not be determined

briefCustomizations.additionalContext: Meeting type could not be determined. Prepare a balanced brief covering all areas.
keyFocus: Review all available context
Be prepared for any direction
Have discovery questions ready
Know product capabilities broadly
briefCustomizations.toneGuidance: Flexible and attentive. Follow their lead.

priority: Keywords in meeting title take highest priority
Gong call history for first call vs follow-up detection
